## Package

Plugin ID, version, and whether this is an executable plugin or theme pack.

## Behavior and data

What it does, requested permissions, external access, and how user data is handled.

## Validation

- [ ] README describes setup, runtime and permissions.
- [ ] `npm run registry` and `npm run verify` pass.
- [ ] Version is new and existing release assets are unchanged.
- [ ] Maintainer: publish and verify the versioned archives before merging the registry.
